meet-divedex.author: Design observation
meet-divedex.body: The page tours introduce too many features at once. It is hard to tell what DiveDex helps divers do.

welcome-entry.author: Classmate / tester
welcome-entry.body: The tour covers too many features at once. DiveDex’s main purpose is hard to grasp.

more-interests.author: Recreational diver
more-interests.body: Onboarding asks little about my interests, so later recommendations feel too general.

home-stages-trimmed.author: Classmate / tester
home-stages-trimmed.body: Home feels crowded and lacks visual variety.

just-exploring.author: Classmate / tester
just-exploring.body: Shortcut labels leave their destinations unclear.

after-a-dive-full.author: Recreational diver
after-a-dive-full.body: Nice to show divers’ own photos in Recent Discoveries.

at-the-spot.author: Classmate / tester
at-the-spot.body: The colour palette feels more suited to a banking app.

collection-views.author: Recreational diver
collection-views.body: The route from Collection to a study is unclear.

explore-full.author: F03 · Instructor
explore-full.body: A map would make dive sites easier to locate.

explore-full.author: Course instructor
explore-full.body: A larger map would make sites easier to see.

at-the-spot-full.author: Classmate / tester
at-the-spot-full.body: It’s easy to lose track of the current section.

explore-wishlist.author: Classmate / tester
explore-wishlist.body: Too much text makes the options hard to compare.

identify-review.author: Recreational diver
identify-review.body: Being able to correct a suggested ID is helpful.

identify-review.author: Design review · AI
identify-review.body: Keep results compact and show details on tap.

identify-full.author: Design review · AI
identify-full.body: Expanding one match hides the other results.

identify-full.author: Recreational diver
identify-full.body: Reviewing matches one by one takes too long.

identify-full.author: Classmate / tester
identify-full.body: High confidence makes a match feel trustworthy.

blue-tang-record-nov9.author: Classmate
blue-tang-record-nov9.body: Short facts would be easier to scan.

recognise-a-blue-tang.author: Design review · AI
recognise-a-blue-tang.body: The fun fact offers few clues for identifying the fish.

recognise-a-blue-tang.author: Design review · AI
recognise-a-blue-tang.body: The name is clear, but key markings are hard to find.

blue-tang-walkthrough.author: Recreational diver
blue-tang-walkthrough.body: Include the diver’s photo in the species record.
